_comment: Copy to skills/<name>.skill.json, or run `crewctl skills new <name>`. Every field except name, description and steps is optional. `crewctl skills plan` shows the SKILL.md this makes before anything is written.
name: replace-with-skill-name
description: Use when <the situation that should load this skill>. <One sentence on what it produces.>
title: Readable title
goal: One or two sentences: what this skill achieves and what done looks like.
when_to_use: A situation that should load it.
steps: First concrete action, with the exact command or tool where it matters.
Next action. Say what to look at in the result.
Stop condition: when to ask the user instead of going on.
output: The exact shape of the answer (headings, fields, how to cite evidence).
gotchas: A mistake this procedure has already hit.
